people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and I will dry up all the rivers of Egypt with the sole of my feet.”
translations.bsb: I have dug wells and drunk foreign waters. With the soles of my feet I have dried up all the streams of Egypt.”
translations.kjv: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of besieged places.
translations.asv: I have digged and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet will I dry up all the rivers of Egypt.
